name: Prefijo de namespace UBL
source: The prefixed XML namespaces every SUNAT document declares on its root element. Transcribed from perunio-facturador/internal/xmlbuilder/namespace.go:8-16. Keyed by prefix rather than by URI so both bindings can name one: Go gets the prefix as a constant and the URI from UblNamespaceUri, TypeScript gets UBL_NAMESPACE_URI['cac'] with the prefix checked at compile time. The default (unprefixed) namespace of each root element lives in ubl-document.json instead — it varies per document, these do not.
